subject: Create Johnny dashboard: Analytics tab with usage metrics
description:
Implement the Analytics tab showing usage metrics, A/B test results, and tier optimization stats in Agent Hub.

**Project:** Agent Hub (~/agent-hub/)

**Skills:** Use `/frontend-design` for UI/UX implementation, `/optimized-nextjs-typescript` for patterns.

**Backend:**
- Create GET /api/johnny/analytics endpoint
- Return aggregated metrics: injection counts, citation rates, tier distributions
- Include A/B variant performance data
- Include tier optimization history

**Frontend:**
- Implement AnalyticsTab component
- Charts for key metrics (use recharts or similar)
- Metric cards with sparklines
- Tier distribution pie chart
- A/B variant comparison table
- Date range selector

**Metrics to Display:**
- Total episodes by tier/scope
- Injection frequency over time
- Citation rate (referenced/loaded ratio)
- Utility score distribution
- A/B variant success rates
- Tier promotion/demotion activity

**Files:**
- ~/agent-hub/backend/app/services/johnny/analytics_service.py (new)
- ~/agent-hub/backend/app/api/johnny.py (analytics endpoint)
- ~/agent-hub/frontend/src/components/johnny/tabs/AnalyticsTab.tsx
- ~/agent-hub/frontend/src/components/johnny/charts/MetricCard.tsx (new)
- ~/agent-hub/frontend/src/components/johnny/charts/TierChart.tsx (new)
- ~/agent-hub/frontend/src/components/johnny/charts/UsageChart.tsx (new)
- ~/agent-hub/frontend/src/lib/johnny-api.ts (analytics endpoint)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] GET /api/johnny/analytics returns aggregated metrics
- [ ] Analytics tab displays metric cards
- [ ] Charts render correctly
- [ ] Date range filter works
- [ ] A/B variant data shown
- [ ] Tier distribution visualized
- [ ] `dt --check` passes
- [ ] `rebuild.sh` completed (in agent-hub)
- [ ] Verified in browser

**Context Check:** If >= 60%, /compact first. If >= 75%, /commit_it then /compact.

**Completion:** Run /commit_it after verification passes.
